reviews.text: Thank you so much for your kind words, Urban. We really appreciate you taking the time out of your day to share your experience with us and other pet owners. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

Great customer service. Everybody is really nice and I really enjoy the doctor he was very kind and has good cat bedside manner. I look forward to coming back and using thrive for all my cats needs in the future.

They're very sweet to my vania. She never comes back scared or anything. I havent been able to take her to get her shots but all the times ive been there they've been really nice and attentive. Very happy pup.
Hi Geraly, thanks for taking the time to share your experience with us! We’re happy to hear you and your pet had a great visit with our team. We are always here if you need anything.
Staff is genuinely concerned about your pet.
I took my German Shepherd here a few years ago for an ear infection. It was a bit pricey but worth it.
We are concerned to hear about your experience. Please contact us at (346) 253-3517 so we can address your concerns directly.
I brought my cat pickles here. They are very friendly and informative. They gave a few treatment options and were understanding of my choice.

The staff are nice and great you promptly. If you need an accommodation they make sure to do their best to make it happen for you. It was clean and the service was super fast I was in and out. The veterinarian listened to all of my concerns and made sure they were all answered by the time we left.
Affordable and caring pet care! Everyone was friendly and attentive, even helping my aggressive senior dog without hesitation. Glad I found you guys!
We’ve taken our 7 year old Husky here for 6 years and have recently taken our pup. The staff always takes great care of our pups and listen to our concerns! They handle our pets so well!

I brought my cat in because I was worried about his breathing, and my regular vet recommended Thrive for x-rays. Everyone was so kind and made him feel comfortable right away. The vet tech had me laughing throughout the entire visit with the conversations she was having with my cat.

The vet called the same day with the results, took the time to explain everything, and really put my mind at ease. The cost was also in line with what I expected based on x-ray prices in the Houston area.

Overall, it was a great experience. I'll definitely bring my little monster back again.
It was an excellent experience.My cat Zoey went in for a vaccine and I must say she was very calm and it was her first time there. Dr. Jane and staff are very nice and caring!
Easy appointment making, fast and knowledgeable staff, and great prices! Highly recommend this place for your pet care!
Great, doctor and assistant Vicky was super sweet. Thank you!

I brought my new puppy here to establish a Vet/care. Staff is friendly and sweet, our room had a lovely welcome sign with his name ❤️ I used the discounts on their website which helped significantly! Very clean, and the visit was quicker than I anticipated!

We had a wonderful experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare! The staff was friendly, caring, and professional, and they made us feel welcome from the moment we arrived. We truly appreciate the excellent care our pet received and highly recommend them.

Very unfriendly and adamant about coming in each time. They only care about the money and not your pet. Over charge snd try to make you get unnecessary treatment.
I highly suggest a different place to take your loved one.  One that cares. !!!!!

I started coming here in March, my dog Casper has a very bad ear infection. At first I felt like they were trying everything to help. We started ear packing in April, I have spent over $800 which wouldn’t be an issue but the fact that there are absolutely no results is.  At my last visit I forgot the ear packing medication and called and told them I could turn around but would be a little late. Instead of rescheduling they told me to come in without it. At this visit we did an ear culture and his right ear was very infected still. So the relief doctor tried to prescribe me a $300 ear drop. When I declined I felt like the Dr was judging me for it and when I asked if I could pick it up in a couple days I was told that whatever Dr that is working that day might not feel comfortable giving me the proscribed medication. Additionally, I saw a new doctor almost everytime I went and they all seemed to not know which ear was the issue. Almost like they don’t read the chat ahead of time. I decided to look for second opinions after that. after my visit with my new vet they informed me that we should have been ear packing every 2 weeks. Which I was not informed about at Thrive. I feel like I wasted my money and prolonged my dogs ear infection for no reason. All of these 5 star reviews are very misleading and I just want to mention that if you work at a vet you should probably know how to deal with dogs that are in pain and scared. Please if you are looking to come here for anything but checkups and vaccines look elsewhere.
Thank you for taking the time to provide a review, Vanessa. Please don't hesitate to send us a message to let us know how to earn a 5 star review on your next visit so we can improve!
Kori is the best! Has helped me so much with my new puppy and older dogs ! Great and fast service !
KORI & VICKY WERE THE BEES KNEES!
Good Experience. The doctor is really nice and she explained everything. I really appreciate
Everyone there rocks and patience
They were so kind and so so quick it was crazy!! I got a discount for just going on a friday!
Easy appointment and the staff are nice
Although it’s quite pricey but overall the vet and staff are friendly and knowledgeable.
very kind staff!
It was nice the team were great and loving to our German Shepherd
I enjoy the Eldridge Thrive clinic Droctors Jones, Alva, Hartke is very compassionate.  Sam  is always in very good hands. I also enjoyed all the techs Jai and Kori. I trust them with Sam's live
So so helpful and friendly!!! I absolutely love this location and recommend it to all my family
Thank you for your valuable feedback! We are delighted to learn of your positive experience here with us!

I brought my two dogs to thrive and I’ve always come to thrive. I live over an hour away but this is the only vet that cares about our animals. the only place my anxiety ridden dog feels safe and secure! DR.Long and Kori are amazing I will be a lifetime patient.
Very sweet People and they take great care of our puppies 💗 …
Came here years ago and my duki loved it then and still loves it now! They’re so sweet with the dogs and actually show that they care!
Very happy with the quick and friendly service received from Dr Long and the staff here. I was able to book an appointment online easily.  I feel comfortable with the diagnosis and will be back!
Everyone is super nice & gave me more help w my baby than any other vet !!
The first thing was seeing kori greet me she's a very sweet person all the staff are nice and sweet I will be coming here from now on they treated my lil baby soooo good

Hi Stacey, thanks for the positive review! We're so happy to hear you and your pet had a great experience with our team. We appreciate your recommendation, and we look forward to your next visit with us.

I went in for a check up on my dog’s ears. I got there 5 mins early but waited like 10 mins to be attended. Appointment took about an hour and a half. Technician and doctor were great. Doctor was very informative and went beyond explaining everything to me. What went from a double digit cost ended up being a triple digit ($300’s). Visit was not cheap as expected. Everything was okay until my dog was returned from treatment with blood all over his ear. They did not even care to clean him up or anything. You pay all that money and still have to go home and clean him up. Only thing great here was the doctor. If you come here be prepared for a very expensive cost plus a “clinical support fee” whatever that means. For there very expensive cost, there treatment is not worth it especially on how they return your animal once they get paid.
Great service and friendly staff!
Nice facility,  did not smell like pets at all! Nice fresh smell. Our Veterinary Tech Kori was wonderful!!! Will continue taking my cat there!!
We've been coming here since we moved to Houston and everybody at Thrive has been awesome.
They took great care of our baby bella on a very hard day for us. Highly recommend the kind staff and shout out to Jai for all your help. Thank you!🐾 👼 …

As far as edicate goes is fine, but unfortunately we had to take our dog back home and watch her die. Did blood work and IV and anti nausea.  Something I could of done at home myself, didn't give her the other 3 shots she needed cause supposedly we said we declined it which was a lie!!! And pretty much the whole time it was all about money!!!! There was nothing to thrive about that place, watch out!!!!!
Great visit today! Dr. Myles was kind and loving and so were the staff!
Very attentive care. Great people!

Easy in and very personable staff.
Dr. Leah was thorough and intentional with her exam and recommendations.
My overly nervous pup felt safe and comfortable.
Glad I found this space.
Aj was great, she was very gentle with my baby from the door and very sweet. She also gave my brother and I plenty of knowledge on my dog and was very very understanding.
Amazing I loved the service everyone is so nice and kind
Thanks for your feedback!
I Love this place, they treat my little puppy like their own, very sweet and nice ladies. Really recommend it
They’ve done a wonderful job caring for my elderly cat!!

Nyla (frenchie) had an amazing experience here at Thrive! I instantly fell in love with how warm, friendly and professional the staff was! This is definitely Nylas new home! The level of care here was amazing!!!!

Its always a pleasure to come here. They have been treating my fur babies since they were puppies and I have no complaints... the staff is always friendly and treat my babies as their own what more can you ask for ...
They did such a great job taking care of my dog
workers are very nice and friendly. the service is great!! definitely recommend coming here!
Thank you for your five star rating !

The staff here are so sincere and polite. They truly care about the animals and what their owners want for them without judgement or prejudice. I am so grateful to have them so close to my home for my cats.
Kori is the greatest
Love coming to this Thrive Per Healthcare on Eldridge. They are always so helpful and attentive when my pup and I come in!

I had a really great experience here! The staff was friendly, professional, and made me feel comfortable right away. The service was efficient, and everything was explained clearly. You can tell they genuinely care about their customers and provide quality service. I definitely recommend this place and will be coming back again!
Very professional and caring ever time we visit. Price is affordable and transparent
Good people great service!!
Came to thrive pet healthcare for the first time and they didn’t disappoint! They offer great services and are quick and efficient. Prices are reasonable. I recommend this place for pet
Been coming here for years. Service is always excellent and everyone always takes such good care of my dog Dobby.
Super helpful, precise and well priced
Great establishment great doctors

We had a wonderful experience at this vet clinic. I came in with my double doodle for an ear infection, and from the moment we walked in, the front staff was warm, welcoming, and incredibly friendly. The veterinarian was just as kind and took the time to explain everything clearly, which made me feel comfortable and confident in the care my dog received.
I often feel like I’m being overcharged at vet offices, but that was definitely not the case here. The pricing was very reasonable, especially for the great service provided. Highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for compassionate care and excellent value!
Cece and I were in and out again today. Always very easy

Very expensive. Be prepared to be taken advantage of and pay huge sums of money without results.
Expect to pay a check up fee which is about $70 MORE than once. They make you pay $70 multiple times because everyday they have a different doctor and they hold you responsible for that instead of paying the $40 re-check up fee for revision. They also gave me IMPROPER MEDICATION for my cat, thanks to Doctor Hartke, totally forgot to mention the meds were supposed to stay in the fridge so it was spoiled. ALSO my cat took antibiotics although there was no infection at all. Doctor Hartke and Doctor Jenna gave me two completely different opinion on my cats situation.
I also need to mention a very UNPROFESSIONAL receptionist, older lady with dark hair, was working there on Saturday December 13th, 2025 around 3:00pm. She yelled at me and absolutely humiliated me. She dismissed my concerns by saying come another day and not caring at all about what I was saying. She did not even try to get help from a doctor or a technician. I expressed to her that I did not want to drive 3 hours of total trips to the clinic because of a mistake the doctor made. She thought it was okay to scream like I was trespassing her own private property because she did not like the tone of my voice. As if I did not have every right to be frustrated after paying more than $500 for ineffective medication. I have never dealt with someone so careless and unprofessional.
The manager was kind and tried to help me, however, that does not cover for the horrible experience I have had.
Great service .

Everyone here is wonderful, from the person who answers the phones, to techs and vets. We started going here with our new cat 4 years ago vs. Banfield which I used for my dog many many yrs ago. They are completely transparent on pricing (no surprises), and if you have a set budget, they'll work with you on adjusting your pet's treatment plan. We were just there for a diagnosis/end of life visit, and they were all so compassionate  through the entire process. I cannot thank them enough for how they all handled an incredibly hard visit. Thank you, Dr.O and staff.

My maltipoo and I were treated good, fair and all questions were answered. I did ask for  prices beforehand.
To not receive any hidden or surprise charges. Our third time to this location.
Thank you for the 5-star rating!

I recently took my German Shepherd to another thrive closer to me and they told me they were unable to help me and. Needed to sedate her and the next appointment wasn’t until Monday which is a few days , anyways they referred me to come to the Eldridge location the next day which was 45 min from my house, but I rather drive far because everyone from the front desk to the vet were so  nice and very patient with us , I will definitely come back to this location.

Great experience with my Rotti who  doesn't like the vet. He is considered a behavioral problem but Thrive and their staff treated him with care and respect. They gave me great options on how they can work with him instead of treating him like a criminal and giving up after one try. They understood his fear and that he just happened to be a big dog with this fear and not an agressive monster. I am happy that they are working with us and giving us excellent advice and service.
They are always so courteous, professional, and thorough!!! We've been coming here for years and never had any issues.

We have tried all thrive vets lol and we totally love the Eldridge one Dr.Myles, Jasmine and Jai were amazing!! We were surprise Milo took the treats from Jai he has never done that he sure did like Jai,Jasmine and Dr.Myles for him to do that! Thank you so much we will be coming with them for anything! You guys are amazing and so nice!! :)

Thrive Pet Healthcare is amazing. They genuinely care for your pet and you. They are friendly, courteous and very informative on what is going on with your pet.  I highly recommend this office for your pet's wellbeing.
Be careful they always over price and make you have to get medication and medicine there super expensive!

First time here and they did a great job with my not so cooperative kitty! Haha
Check in process was quick and easy and we were able to get into a room to see the vet with no issue with our appointment. Prices are reasonable and they have Saturday appointments as well.

Our most recent experience with Thrive was a great one. We've been going there for about 7 years and it's been hit or miss. Our dog has severe anxiety when it comes to vet visits. This was our 2nd attempt to draw blood. The tech( AJ) along with another tech took their time and were very kind and knowledgeable. It was a very pleasant and successful visit.
Thank you for the 5-star rating!
The clinic is very nice and the people working there are very professional and polite as well. Very competent staff however prices are a little higher than I was hoping they would be.
Staff is so very sweet.  Affordable pet care
Thank you for the 5-star rating!

This was my first time talking my dog there w an ear infection due to allergies. Jasmine and the doctor were able to get a prescription filled and now my dogs ears have improved. I'll be going back to Thrive, and I'm thankful to their staff for helping OB out quickly.
Thank you to Dr. Hartke for taking good care of my baby and thank you Jasmine for being so kind and personable 🥰 …

I’ve been going to Thrive since Mocha was a puppy — and she’ll be 5 this August! It’s not the first time I’ve worked with Jasmine, and she’s always so kind and thoughtful with us. She consistently treats both Mocha and Cookie with genuine care and friendliness, which not all technicians show — and it really makes a difference.
At today’s visit, Jasmine clearly explained the estimated cost before giving both Cookie and Mocha their allergy injections and anal gland expression. She took the time to make sure I understood everything, and I truly appreciated that. On top of that, she gave them both cute, colorful bandanas and even told us about the upcoming summer party on June 28th!
Thank you, Jasmine, for always making our visits smooth, kind, and personal.
